name: Street Custom 'Packrat' Concealed Carry Harness
description: A body-worn harness system designed to conceal multiple weapons, tools, and equipment under standard clothing. The Packrat uses a modular design of pouches, holsters, and clips arranged across the torso, inner thighs, and small of back to distribute weight evenly and minimize visible printing through fabric. A well-fitted Packrat can conceal a pistol, three magazines, a knife, a cyberdeck, a medical kit, and assorted tools without creating visible bulges or asymmetric weight distribution. The harness is custom-fitted to the wearer's body and adjustable for different clothing styles. It has become the standard concealment system for anyone who needs to carry lethal capability through areas where weapons are not welcome.
legality: Legal — concealment harness; illegal if containing prohibited items

specifications.capacity: Pistol + 3 magazines + knife + cyberdeck + med kit + tools
specifications.accessibility: Draw times under 1.5 seconds for primary weapon

story_hooks: A security checkpoint missed a complete weapons loadout on a suspect who was wearing a custom Packrat — the harness was specifically designed to distribute metal mass below the detection threshold of the checkpoint's scanners.
A Packrat design has been developed with integrated Faraday pouches that shield contained devices from tracking — anything stored in the harness disappears from electronic detection.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Proprioceptive Lattice Sleeve

physical_description.visual_profile: A sophisticated body harness system comprising interconnected modular pouches and holsters arranged in a tactical grid pattern across the torso and thighs. The design resembles a minimalist load-bearing vest but far more compact and concealable, with a skeletal frame of webbing and anchor points rather than a solid backing. When laid flat, it appears almost like a body-map blueprint of storage capacity.
physical_description.dimensions: Custom-fitted to individual wearer; typical harness spans 45-60cm vertically across torso, with thigh components extending 20-25cm down each leg
physical_description.weight_description: Lightweight and highly portable when empty (0.5kg); distributes load across multiple body points to feel like natural weight distribution even when fully loaded
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-duty nylon webbing with neoprene backing; reinforced stitching at stress points
physical_description.finish: Matte textured surface with minimal reflectivity to prevent light catch; wear patterns visible on high-friction areas from repeated draw cycles
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey primary webbing with black neoprene backing; accent stitching in gunmetal grey or muted olive depending on customization
physical_description.interface_elements: Modular snap-fit connectors throughout; adjustable retention straps with subtle pull-tabs; quick-release buckles on shoulder loops; reinforced D-rings and carabiners at key anchor points; internal elastic loops for tool organization; velcro patches for customizable pouch arrangement
distinctive_features: Asymmetric pouch arrangement optimized for specific load-outs and body contours
Neoprene backing creates subtle compression against body while wicking moisture
Internal cable routing channels to keep tool cords organized and invisible
Thigh component designed to sit flush against leg even during movement
Custom-dyed sections matching individual wearer's skin tone variants in the GLMZ population
Micro-textured grip surfaces on holster retention points
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Embossed 'Street Custom' logo on rear center panel; small regulatory tag sewn discreetly into interior seam; no barcode or serial number visible (by design)
physical_description.condition_typical: Shows wear patterns from repeated access; holster leather slightly darkened from sweat and oil; some velcro patches worn smooth from frequent reattachment; micro-scratches on metal carabiners from daily tool contact

image_prompt: Product photography of a custom tactical concealment harness laid flat on a worn steel workbench under cool cyan-blue lighting, partially backlit to show the skeletal webbing structure. The harness is arranged to display its modular pouch system and thigh components, with a single 9mm pistol and spare magazine positioned near the primary holster to suggest capacity. Neoprene backing visible where webbing folds, showing the matte grey nylon texture and worn velcro patches. Dramatic shadows cast across the harness emphasize its three-dimensional anchor points and D-rings. A small embossed 'Street Custom' logo visible on the rear panel. Background is blurred concrete and scattered tools, GLMZ gritty aesthetic. Neo-noir color grading with slight magenta and cyan color cast. --ar 3:2 --v 6
